title: Relier deux actions avec le gérondif
summary: Use en + present participle for simultaneous action, means and conditions with a shared subject.
objectives: Form regular and three irregular gerunds.
Keep the implied subject of the gerund the same as the main subject.
Distinguish while/by meanings and retain reflexive pronouns.

sources.label: B1 public topic index (coverage reference only)

sections.title: Start from nous, but do not keep a person ending
paragraphs: The gerund is en + a present participle. Usually remove -ons from the present nous form and add -ant: nous parlons gives en parlant; nous finissons gives en finissant; nous prenons gives en prenant. This form is not conjugated for different persons and does not agree in gender or number.

Three common irregular forms are avoir: en ayant, être: en étant, savoir: en sachant. Spelling protects pronunciation: nous mangeons gives en mangeant, nous commençons gives en commençant. Verbs in -ger keep e before a; verbs in -cer need ç before a.

A reflexive pronoun stays before the participle and agrees with the person doing the action: en me levant, en te levant, en se levant, en nous levant, en vous levant, en se levant. Negation can surround the participle group: en ne parlant pas, en ne se pressant pas.
points: Vocabulary: une notice (feminine), an instruction leaflet; une poignée (feminine), a handle.
Do not confuse invariable verbal en fatiguant with an agreeing adjective such as une journée fatigante.

examples.french: Elle vérifie l'adresse **en lisant** le message.
examples.english: She checks the address while reading the message.

examples.note: Mangeant keeps e to preserve the soft g.

examples.french: Tu progresseras **en commençant** par des phrases courtes.
examples.english: You will improve by starting with short sentences.

examples.french: **En te levant** plus tôt, tu éviteras la circulation.
examples.english: By getting up earlier, you will avoid the traffic.

mistakes.why: The gerund does not agree with the subject.

sections.title: While, by or if: read the relationship
paragraphs: The gerund can show simultaneity, two actions happening together: écouter en marchant. It can show a means or method: apprendre en pratiquant. In an instruction, it can imply a condition: en tournant à gauche, vous verrez la mairie, if you turn left, you will see the town hall.

Tout en often reinforces simultaneity and can add a contrast: elle reste polie tout en exprimant son désaccord, she remains polite while expressing disagreement. It does not require a new tense or a change to the participle. Do not translate every English -ing form with en: I like reading is j'aime lire, not j'aime en lisant.
points: The gerund itself has no person or tense ending; the main clause supplies the time reference.
Choose a relationship the reader can infer; if the link is unclear, write two complete clauses.

examples.french: Vous économiserez du papier **en imprimant** recto verso.
examples.english: You will save paper by printing on both sides.

examples.french: **En tournant** à droite, vous trouverez l'accueil.
examples.english: If you turn right, you will find reception.

examples.french: Il prend des notes **tout en écoutant**.
Elle reste calme **tout en refusant** la proposition.
examples.english: She stays calm while refusing the proposal.

sections.title: The same person normally does both actions
paragraphs: In standard careful usage, the implied subject of a gerund is the subject of the main clause. En ouvrant la porte, j'ai vu le jardin means I opened the door and I saw the garden. En ouvrant la porte, le jardin était magnifique incorrectly makes the garden the understood opener in an ordinary reading.

When the subjects differ, use a full time clause such as pendant que or quand: Pendant que je préparais le repas, les enfants jouaient. Some fixed expressions do not follow the simple shared-subject test, but do not use those exceptions to justify unclear everyday sentences.
points: Check the actor before trying to make a sentence shorter.

examples.french: **En étant** plus précis, nous éviterons les malentendus.
examples.english: By being more precise, we will avoid misunderstandings.
examples.note: Nous is the subject of both being and avoiding.

examples.french: Elle accepte **en sachant** que le délai est court.
examples.english: She accepts knowing that the deadline is short.
examples.note: Savoir has the irregular form sachant.

examples.french: **En ayant** tous les documents sous les yeux, vous pourrez répondre plus vite.
examples.english: By having all the documents in front of you, you will be able to answer faster.
examples.note: Avoir has the irregular form ayant.

mistakes.avoid: En arrivant à la gare, le train était déjà parti.
mistakes.prefer: Quand je suis arrivé à la gare, le train était déjà parti.
mistakes.why: The traveller arrived, not the train. Give the arriving action its own subject rather than attaching it to le train.

practice.prompt: Give the gerund of finir, including en.
Give the gerund of prendre, including en.
Give the gerund of être, including en.
practice.explanation: Être has the irregular participle étant.

practice.prompt: In On apprend en pratiquant, what relationship does en pratiquant express?
practice.explanation: Practising is how the same subject learns.

practice.prompt: Give the gerund of commencer, including en.
practice.explanation: Ç preserves the soft c before a.

practice.prompt: Give the gerund of manger, including en.
Give the gerund of avoir, including en.
practice.explanation: Avoir gives ayant, not avant or avoyant.

practice.prompt: Give the gerund of savoir, including en.
Supply se préparer as a gerund for nous, including en: Nous discutons ___.
practice.explanation: The reflexive pronoun must match nous.

practice.prompt: Supply parler as a gerund, including en: Elles marchent ___.
practice.explanation: No feminine or plural agreement is added.

practice.prompt: Choose the sentence whose gerund and main verb have the same actor.
choices: En ouvrant le dossier, j'ai trouvé la facture.
En ouvrant le dossier, la facture était froissée.
answers: En ouvrant le dossier, j'ai trouvé la facture.
practice.explanation: Je opens and finds; a facture cannot open a folder.

practice.prompt: Supply the word that reinforces simultaneity: Elle écrit ___ en écoutant.
practice.explanation: Tout en emphasizes the actions occurring together.

practice.prompt: Give the negative gerund of parler with ne ... pas, including en.
practice.explanation: Ne and pas surround the participle.

practice.prompt: Supply se lever as a gerund for vous, including en.
practice.explanation: Reflexive vous precedes the invariable levant.

practice.prompt: Choose the standard expression for I like reading.
practice.explanation: An English -ing complement is not automatically a French gerund.

practice.prompt: Give the gerund of réfléchir, including en.

production_task.prompt: Explain how you prepare for an oral presentation. Use one gerund for a method, one for simultaneous activity, one reflexive gerund and one irregular form. Make sure the main subject performs each gerund action.
production_task.model_answer: Je prépare mon intervention en notant trois idées essentielles. Je m'entraîne tout en regardant l'horloge. En me préparant à voix haute, je repère les phrases trop longues. En étant plus précis, je rends mon message plus clair.
production_task.translation: I prepare my presentation by noting three essential ideas. I practise while watching the clock. By preparing aloud, I identify sentences that are too long. By being more precise, I make my message clearer.
rubric: Derive regular forms from the present nous stem.
Match the reflexive pronoun and the implied actor to the main subject.
Make the means or simultaneous relationship clear.
